test_constant_staleness_weight: test the ConstantStalenessWeight class to verify it always returns a normalized weight of 1.0
test_threshold_staleness_weight: test the ThresholdStalenessWeight class to verify weight drops to value_after_cutoff beyond the cutoff staleness
test_polynomial_staleness_weight: test the PolynomialStalenessWeight class to verify polynomial decay weighting based on the exponent parameter
test_polynomial_weight_zero_exponent: test that PolynomialStalenessWeight returns weight of 1.0 when the exponent is set to zero
test_polynomial_weight_bad_exponent: test that PolynomialStalenessWeight raises an error when the exponent is outside the valid 0 to 1 range
